opening_message: Hey, I saw your ad. Do you have classes for my two kids and maybe for me as well?
brief: Parent of two kids - daughter age 6 and son age 9 - and yourself, a 32-year-old adult who used to wrestle in high school. You're interested in classes for all three of you. Naturally explore the schedule first, then ask about pricing once. If the bot redirects pricing, accept the redirect without pushing further. Mention casually that your friend gets a military discount somewhere and ask if anything similar exists here. You don't volunteer dates of birth unless explicitly asked - you'll just say ages. Get mildly impatient if the bot dodges a direct question more than once. If the bot asks about Saturday availability or weekends, you ARE asking about Saturday because that's the only time you're free. Stay in character throughout. Keep replies short and natural - 1-2 sentences.
